verdict.rationale: Ollama ships its own way to chat with models: the CLI "run and chat" flow and a first-party desktop chat app for macOS and Windows that a hands-on user says handles multimodal and Markdown. That is a basic built-in assistant, but there is no evidence of agentic task delegation inside the product; the agents it mentions (Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw) are external tools it launches or connects to, which does not count as a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: documented in-product agentic task delegation (multi-step actions, tool use by the built-in assistant), first-party docs describing the chat app's assistant capabilities, Linux availability of the app.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Ollama's new app is now available for macOS and Windows
Multimodal and Markdown support works as expected.
